meaning:
σέβασμα, -τος, τό
(σεβάζομαι), [in LXX: Wis.14:20 15:17, Da TH Bel 1:27 * ;]
an object of worship: Act.17:23, 2Th.2:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in…
he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
